records.context: With ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (item 980) no AI is asked: every UniProt GO term and keyword of the screening experiment's genes, and every CORUM complex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) and Reactome pathway (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), is tested in each cluster by a one-sided hypergeometric test against all the screening experiment's genes, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the cluster's terms. The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screening experiment's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. The same tables are written, plus ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; the reference files are copied with their checksum and date so a rerun works offline.

The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screen's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. records.translation: Með ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (atriði 980) er engin gervigreind spurð: hvert UniProt GO-hugtak og lykilorð gena skimunarinnar, og hver CORUM-flóki (``ops_voyager3_corum``) og Reactome-ferill (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), er prófað í hverjum klasa með einhliða yfirrúmfræðilegu prófi gegn öllum genum skimunarinnar, með Benjamini-Hochberg-FDR yfir hugtök klasans. Besta hugtakið með FDR í mesta lagi ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, með minnst 3 klasagen og tvöfalt hlutfall skimunarinnar, nefnir hlutverkið; hlutfall klasagenanna sem bera það gefur sömu vissuorðin, og í high- og medium-klösum eru genin án þess kandídatarnir. Sömu töflur eru skrifaðar, auk ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; viðmiðunarskrárnar eru afritaðar með gátsummu sinni og dagsetningu svo að endurkeyrsla virki án nettengingar.
